title: Choose the visual world for Henna by Hamna
question: The roll assigned Wedding Ephemera. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Wedding Ephemera
options.lineage: South Asian wedding stationery and heirloom invitation suites
options.thesis: The wedding invitation as a living keepsake — every service a card in the bride's suite.
options.viewport: A wedding-invitation suite opening onto the brand — a foil-stamped name card, then services as keepsake cards.
options.risk: Risks reading as a static greeting card if the cards don't interact or lift like real keepsakes.

options.label: The Journey Wallet
options.lineage: jet-age airline ticket wallets and boarding stubs
options.thesis: Booking Henna by Hamna as one leg of the bride's journey — a coupon book where each service tears off in sequence.
options.case: Fuses well: services map cleanly to tear-off coupons, but the aviation vocabulary is foreign to a wedding-bound bride's world.

options.label: The Bridal Arrangement
options.lineage: bridal trousseau and wedding-day styling boards
options.thesis: The wedding-day styling board — each service a piece of the bride's trousseau, styled like the art she commissions.
options.case: Fuses well: services as trousseau pieces, warm and bridal; risks treading near the category's expected look.

options.label: The Henna Craft Book
options.lineage: skilled artisan's ledger — the hand, the recipe, the process
options.thesis: The craft book of the henna artist: the hand that draws, the paste she mixes, the design she drafts — as pages of a working studio ledger.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: an artist's process ledger reads as expertise; risks losing the bridal occasion in favor of the craft.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What this category ships, executed impeccably — the elegant warm-toned bridal promo, at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: The arrangement a visitor expects, at full craft.
